req_desc: The app serves a public corporate site, an editorial console, from one content store.

The app creates a delegation at `POST /api/workflow/delegations` ...

The app sends a correction of a published release through the chain again ...
The app serialises transitions per record ...

The app shows a notification inside the console only ...

The app sets a disclosure class at `POST /api/content/records/{id}/classify` ...
The app refuses a move out of `compliance_review` on a record carrying no class.
The app refuses a move from `approved` straight to `published` on a `market_sensitive` record ...
The app holds every controlled text in the policy register ...
The app creates a version rather than editing a version on a register change.
The app resolves a disclaimer at publication against the register version then in force ...
The app renders no register entry whose effective-from instant lies in the future ...
The app flags a register entry overdue for review in the console ...
The app schedules an approved record at `POST /api/workflow/records/{id}/schedule` ...
The app rejects an embargo instant lying in the past at the transition ...

The app renders an embargoed record in full to a publisher on the record's division under a persistent banner naming the release instant.

The app records the delay on a record published more than 60 seconds after the record's instant.
The app returns an embargoed record to `approved` at `DELETE /api/workflow/records/{id}/schedule` ...
The app executes a write carrying an idempotency key once ...
The app writes media bytes to the `minio` bucket, nowhere else ...
The app writes every object under the key scheme `media/{division_key}/{record_id}/{sha256_of_bytes}.{ext}` ...
The app refuses a media record carrying an empty `alt_text`.
The app carries a focal point on every media record ...
The app strips embedded metadata from an uploaded image on receipt ...
The app returns bytes at `GET /api/media/{mediaId}` to a principal entitled to the owning record ...
The app renders a generated placeholder derived from the record identifier where a record needing an image has none ...

The app accepts an enquiry at `POST /api/public/enquiries` from an anonymous visitor ...
The app declares the validation rules once on the server ...
The app holds field messages as authored strings rather than generating the messages from the rules.
The app checks a field blurred carrying a value ...

The app resolves a Swiss country or a European country to the jurisdiction `CH`, answered from Geneva ...
The app writes the enquiry record before answering the visitor ...
The app replaces the form in place with the confirmation without navigating away ...
The app preserves every typed value on a rejected validation ...
The app asks a first-time visitor once about anything beyond the strictly necessary ...
The app measures document views, download counts, search terms on the server from the request path ...

The app exposes no endpoint updating an audit entry ...
The app keeps every stored entry's previous-entry hash equal to the preceding entry's own hash.
The app queries the trail by actor, by resource, by action, by division, by decision, by time range ...
The app answers who approved a release, when, in one query ...
The app offers no mass-deletion path ...
The app voids approvals, returns the record to `draft`, tells the approvers, when an author edits an approved release before publication.
The app leaves approvals standing, recording the change, when an author edits only the image credit.
The app lets a principal holding both reviewer roles complete one stage, refusing the other on the same submission.
The app bars the author from approving after an approver delegates to the author.
The app accepts one of two simultaneous publications of one release, rejecting the other with a conflict ...
The app refuses a `market_sensitive` release leaving `compliance_review` without an embargo.
The app completes a submission in flight under the chain version recorded on the submission.
The app collapses a redirect chain when the second redirect is written.
The app blocks publication of a record referencing media not checked for malware ...
The app preserves a draft for a successor when a principal is deactivated mid-edit.
The app keeps the filter chips visible, offering a control that clears the chips, on an archive filtered to nothing.
The app keeps the last known counter value in place where `GET /api/public/counters` is unavailable.
The app keeps every route fully functional where a visitor refuses every non-essential choice.
The app rejects a media call as `dependency_unavailable` where the object store does not answer ...
The app serves `/` as the group home, anonymous ...
The app lands an anonymous request for a `/console` route on `/console/login` ...
The app lists `Calder Trading`, `Calder Capital` in the rail for `author@example.com` ...
The app shows a submitted release in the first inbox queue of a legal reviewer ...
The app moves a record to `approved` after a compliance approval.
The app advances the header counter by one after an embargo instant passes ...
The app renders the remaining three cards at `/news/?page=2` with nine published releases.
The app names the Singapore office as the responder on a confirmation for an Asian country ...
The app resolves the old address of a retitled published release.
The app names the filters that emptied a filtered archive ...
The app reads on the public site as a large, serious, multi-business group whose word carries authority ...
The app reads the public site as corporate-editorial: atmosphere permitted, the subject seen before the chrome ...
The app commits to a light mode, designing the light mode fully ...
The app draws the palette from one brand blue, a long pale ramp beneath the blue, almost nothing else ...

The app renders every circular control as a true circle ...

The app carries three motion roles, no fourth ...
